summary_1line: Duryodhana’s envoy Uluka delivers a taunting message to the Pandavas, mocking their past humiliations and boasting of the Kaurava army before the coming battle.

image_candidates.scene_text: Uluka stands in the Pandava camp before Yudhishthira, Krishna, and assembled kings, boldly reciting Duryodhana’s harsh message.
Turning toward Arjuna, Uluka mocks him before the gathered warriors, daring him to fight while Krishna stands beside him.
Uluka vividly describes the Kaurava army as a vast ocean of warriors with Bhishma, Drona, Karna, and others as monstrous sea creatures within it.
